title: Helpdesk Administrator
description: Helpdesk Administrator Salary: Up to 27,000 DOE Location: Medway Hours: Monday - Friday, 8am - 5pm (1-hour unpaid lunch break) Are you an experienced Helpdesk Administrator looking for your next opportunity within a friendly, supportive and growing business? We are working exclusively with a fantastic client based in Medway who is looking to welcome a confident, enthusiastic and outgoing Helpdesk Administrator to their team. This is a great opportunity to join a business with a relaxed working environment, where teamwork is key and the engineers are at the heart of everything they do. They're looking for someone with a positive attitude, a strong work ethic and previous experience within a facilities maintenance helpdesk environment. The Day-to-Day Responsibilities: - Managing the shared inbox alongside the wider team and monitoring client portals. - Processing and submitting supplier invoices to clients' accounts teams to ensure costs are included within final invoices. - Delivering excellent customer service to both clients and engineers, ensuring jobs run smoothly from start to finish. - Coordinating and scheduling engineers for reactive maintenance jobs, keeping track of their locations and availability. - Building positive working relationships with engineers, ensuring service levels and business expectations are met. - Prioritising work for key clients alongside incoming reactive maintenance requests. - Raising, updating and closing job tickets across client portals and internal systems. - Chasing engineers for job reports and any additional information required. - Developing your skills in preparing client quotations and confidently following these up. What We're Looking For: - Previous experience working within a facilities maintenance helpdesk environment is essential. - A friendly, bubbly and outgoing personality with a positive approach to work. - Excellent communication and customer service skills. - Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities. - High attention to detail and good IT skills. - A proactive attitude and willingness to learn and progress. - Someone who enjoys working as part of a close-knit team and building relationships. What's In It For You? - Salary of up to 27,000, depending on experience. - Regular rewards and opportunities for salary increases. - A relaxed, welcoming and supportive working environment. - Opportunities for internal progression into more senior positions. - 20 days annual leave plus bank holidays. - Regular team socials and events. - Pension scheme. - Onsite parking. Interested in finding out more? If you're an experienced Facilities Maintenance Helpdesk Administrator who enjoys a fast-paced role, building relationships and being part of a great team, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Summary: Job Title: Customer Service Advisor (Call Center) Location: Snodland, Kent, UK (In-person) Salary: £25,948.87 + Performance based bonus + Benefits Are you looking to join a team that shares your passion for providing excellent customer service? Are you a determined individual? Do you enjoy a sense of achievement when hitting targets and goals? If so, this is a chance you won't want to pass up! We are recruiting for multiple roles for several critical positions within our fast-paced, friendly, and award-winning Customer Service team. As part of your role you will understand your customer's point of view and make them feel heard. Your warmth, passion, and commitment will assist us in getting it right the first time for our customers. No two days are the same. Upon starting within our call centre, you'll help customers with water bills, refunds, payment plans, and occupant changes. You'll also be ready to assist if they have problems with their water supply. If you enjoy working towards targets, love problem solving, and take satisfaction in delivering the best solutions possible, then this is the role for you. Working on a full time 37 hour week, you'll be assigned a shift pattern that includes one Saturday every six weeks. These shifts can be any time Monday through Friday, 08:00 - 19:00, and on the one Saturday, 08:00 - 13:00. The rotas are created in advance so that you are able to plan around them. This position also offers numerous prospects for progression. For example, most of our management began their careers as Customer Service Advisors. You'll have the opportunity to move throughout the department to learn new skills and try out for other roles. As a result, now is a perfect opportunity to launch a successful career and contribute to the success of our Customer Service team. Main responsibilities: - Take calls from South Eastern Water Customers and assist with their requests, queries or complaints. - Provide an excellent customer experience by being flexible to resolve all customer contacts within the company timescales and contribute to customer satisfaction score. - Maintain focus on meeting targets and adhere to business processes, data protection, regulatory compliance and attendance. - Build relationships with peers and colleagues to enhance the team working environment, resolve customer problems and ensure successful productivity. - Proactively use information and resources to ensure that skills and knowledge are kept up to date and continuously developed. - Attend and contribute to team meetings with team, peers and colleagues. - To be available to support the business in peak periods by covering post room and reception duties and by being part of a standby rota emergency periods. What you'll need: Essential Skills / Qualifications / Experience - Commitment to providing excellent customer service - Dedication to finding the best solutions to problems - Excellent computer abilities - Outstanding writing and vocal communication abilities - Ability to handle frequent phone calls via headset throughout most of your working day Desirable Skills / Qualifications / Experience - Previous customer service / call centre experience would be advantageous but is not essential What to expect from our recruitment process: - Initial CV review - Invitation to complete online video recording of yourself answering qualifying questions - Invitation to attend assessment day onsite with us at Snodland alongside other candidates for a morning/afternoon of group activities, collaboration, and a short final interview. Grow a career with a meaningful purpose. We know the communities we serve are diverse. We recognise creativity comes from diversity not similarity. That's why we are enthusiastic about creating inclusion across age, race, gender, ethnicity, religion and identity. You will experience our dedication to equal opportunities and fair treatment for all: through your recruitment, employment and career progression with South East Water. Benefits package: - Excellent Stakeholder pension scheme, up to 10% employer contribution. - 5 weeks holiday plus bank holidays per annum, increasing to 6 weeks with length of service. - Flexible annual leave policy to buy or sell holiday leave. - Paid volunteering days. - Cycle to work scheme. - Health cash plan. - Life assurance. - Wellbeing related benefits. What can you expect from your recruitment? - To apply for this position, please submit your CV on our career's website. - It is necessary for you to have the legal right to work in the UK when you begin employment with South East Water. - Additionally, as part of the employment offer, you will need to pass background, identity, and employment referencing checks. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, apply now! South East Water kindly asks that recruitment agencies refrain from submitting CVs to our employees or associates without explicit invitation from our HR Resourcing team. CVs sent on a speculative basis will not be acknowledged and will not assume any responsibility for fees or commissions in the event that we hire a candidate who applied directly or subsequently introduced by an instructed agency. Compensation package: £25,948.87 starting salary + bonus

title: Customer Service Apprentice
description: Summary: Do you want to jump-start your career while earning a well-regarded qualification? Do you have a strong desire to help others? Do you want to be a part of an award-winning team with a meaningful purpose? Then do not pass up this opportunity We have regular apprenticeship intakes with a guaranteed, permanent position on successful completion. As a Customer Service Apprentice, you will use your entire passion, drive, and willingness to give great service. And with so much variation, you can be sure that no two days will ever be the same. You'll aid with billing inquiries, providing refunds, and setting up payment plans, as well as resolving water supply concerns including leaks and other problems. The Institute of Customer Service has given our Customer Service team the distinction grade. We are one of just 18 organisations in the country to get this coveted honour. As a result, you'll be joining a team that provides their all. This is a structured 24-month apprenticeship that includes group workshops, individual training, and other assignments in addition to on-the-job learning. On your road to completing a Customer Service Specialist Level 3 Apprenticeship and securing a permanent career at the end of the apprenticeship programme, you can expect plenty of encouragement and support from your Trainers, Team Managers, Mentors, and Buddies. It's not a problem if you don't have much work experience. We know you'll bring a lot of determination and a strong desire to succeed. So, what's most crucial is that you work well as a team and are comfortable speaking in with others. In this role, you'll focus on three key areas of performance: handling calls efficiently, maintaining quality, and providing the greatest customer experience possible. We understand the importance of progressing in your career. As a result, your salary will rise as you progress through your apprenticeship. When you join, you'll be a part of one of our call centre teams. We're open Monday through Friday from 8:00 until 19:00 and on Saturday from 8:00 until 13:00. As a result, you will be able to schedule your shifts so that 1 in 6 Saturdays are worked. Your rotas will be available in advance so that you may make plans. With monthly and quarterly bonuses offered based on your performance and assisting us in providing the greatest levels of customer satisfaction, you can earn additional money in addition to your income. On average, you can anticipate earning an additional £3,000 annually, with a possible maximum of £6,300. Main responsibilities: - Develop and build knowledge of the Customer Service area by completing the apprentice pathway - Understand the importance of the business areas, the processes, data protection, regulatory compliance and attendance. - Begin to build relationships with peers and colleagues to enhance the team working environment, resolve customer problems. - Develop an awareness of information and resources available and proactively ensure that skills and knowledge are deepened to enable progression. - Attend and contribute to team meetings with team, peers and colleagues. - Complete customer service level 3 apprenticeship. You'll need: Skills / Qualifications / Experience - Achieved GCSE Maths and English at Grade 4/C (or equivalent) - Excellent computer abilities - You'll have a passion for serving others and providing the best service - Good time management skills supporting you to complete the apprenticeship - Be self-assured conversing with others and engaging with new and different individuals - Be goal-focused and like overcoming difficulties It will be a bonus if you have: Skills / Qualifications / Experience - Experience and understanding of the importance of excellent customer satisfaction Employees are required to be flexible and to be prepared to perform duties and other tasks within their capabilities. The nature of our business is such that the contents of any job profile are subject to change from time to time. We want to be the water company people want to be supplied by and want to work for. We know the communities we serve are diverse. We recognise creativity comes from diversity not similarity. That's why we are enthusiastic about creating inclusion across age, race, gender, ethnicity, religion and identity. You will experience our dedication to equal opportunities and fair treatment for all: through your recruitment, employment and career progression with South East Water. Benefits package: - Excellent Stakeholder pension scheme, up to 10% employer contribution. - 5 weeks holiday plus bank holidays per annum, increasing to 6 weeks with length of service. - Flexible annual leave policy to buy or sell holiday leave. - Paid volunteering days. - Cycle to work scheme. - Health cash plan. - Life assurance. - Wellbeing related benefits. What can you expect from your recruitment? - To apply for this position, please submit your CV on our career's website. - It is necessary for you to have the legal right to work in the UK when you begin employment with South East Water. - Additionally, as part of the employment offer, you will need to pass background, identity, and employment referencing checks. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, apply now! South East Water kindly asks that recruitment agencies refrain from submitting CVs to our employees or associates without explicit invitation from our HR Resourcing team. CVs sent on a speculative basis will not be acknowledged and will not assume any responsibility for fees or commissions in the event that we hire a candidate who applied directly or subsequently introduced by an instructed agency. Compensation package: Starting at £19,067.06 and increasing to £25,948.87 over 24 months

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: CUSTOMER SERVICE ADVISOR - CCU/OUTBOUND CLAIMS SUPPORT Location: Tunbridge Wells Workstyle: Minimum 60% office based Hours: 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 8:30am-5:30pm Rate: 13.39 Start Date: asap Contract: Initially 6 months with a view to permanent, subject to performance meeting expected levels ABOUT THE ROLE Do you get a kick out of solving problems? Are you energized by speaking to customers? We're looking for a Customer Service Advisor to join our front-line claims team and help us deliver a seamless experience to customers when they need it most. You'll develop strong expertise in our claims processes and services, becoming someone customers can rely on following an incident. Through proactive outbound contact, you'll guide customers through their claim journey, keeping them informed and ensuring they receive the right support at the right time. Working in a fast-paced, supportive environment, you'll help deliver the level of service our customers expect from the AA. Some conversations may be complex or involve customers who are upset or frustrated-but that's where teamwork shines. Our colleagues support each other through challenging situations to achieve the best outcomes for our customers. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING - Make outbound calls to customers, third parties, repairers, and other stakeholders to progress claims efficiently - Gather key information, assess claim circumstances, and use your judgement to determine the best course of action - Continuously build your knowledge of our products, services, and claims processes to support diverse customer needs - Use available tools and resources to deliver the best possible outcomes - Manage your workload effectively, staying organised and focused while maintaining consistent, high-quality service ABOUT YOU We're looking for someone with: - Previous customer service experience, ideally within a call centre or telephony environment - A proactive approach-someone who takes initiative and doesn't wait to be told what to do - Good written English for case notes and internal communications - Strong communication skills and professional demeanour on the phone-your communication style is key to creating a great customer experience - The ability to remain calm and empathetic when dealing with frustrated customers IMPORTANT NOTE Please note: if you have annual leave within the first 4 weeks of employment, your application may not be automatically progressed. Guidant, Carbon 60, Lorien & SRG - The Vertage Group Portfolio are acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.
